operation: APFS copy-on-write consolidation of identical retained copies
scope: Closed audited175-176 compiled archive/object copies and large sealed164-176 temporary audit copies only. Canonical current evidence and committed audit files never replaced; prior consolidation targets excluded.
metadata_boundary: Bytes, mode, uid, gid and mtime retain their inventory identity. Each replacement preserves its immediately preceding atime; audit reads may have changed atime since inventory. Inode, ctime and birth time can change. No historical access-time or filesystem identity claim.
